page_title: MON 3-0 BOC | B. Monchengladbach v Bochum 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Lukas Ullrich.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) comes onto the pitch so that Rocco Reitz can be given a rest.

86' 3 - 0 Goal! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 3:0.

86' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the middle of the target. His effort isn't powerful nor precise enough, allowing Patrick Drewes to keep the ball out of the net.
86' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
85' Dieter Hecking is stunned as referee Matthias Jollenbeck shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
85' Patrick Drewes (Bochum) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
85' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
84' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for B. Monchengladbach! Let's see what he decides.
84' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
82' The substitution has been made. Mats Pannewig (Bochum) has replaced Ibrahima Sissoko.
82' Substitution. Jakov Medic is replaced by Cristian Gamboa (Bochum).
81' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Kevin Stoger will be replaced by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach).
80' A substitution has been made. Robin Hack goes off and Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
79' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
78' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
78' It will be a corner kick for Bochum.
77' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
77' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' The attendance is 54042.
77' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
74' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
71' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
68' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Tomas Cvancara and he is replaced by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
67' B. Monchengladbach win a corner.
66' The resulting corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.
61' Substitution. Felix Passlack will be replaced by Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum).
61' Dieter Hecking prepares a substitution. Anthony Losilla is replaced by Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) is replacing Myron Boadu.
59' The corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is intercepted by the defence.
57' Felix Passlack (Bochum) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
57' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Dieter Hecking (Bochum) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.

55' 2 - 0 Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Patrick Drewes is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 2:0.
54' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bochum.
48' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
44' The ball goes out for a corner. B. Monchengladbach can continue in their attacking effort.
40' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
38' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jakov Medic (Bochum) brought his opponent down.
34' 1 - 0 Kevin Stoger finds Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the right post. What a clinical finish to make it 1:0.
34' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
30' The possession of the ball – 63:37.
26' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
21' Bochum fail to score from a corner as Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to collect the ball.
18' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Philipp Hofmann (Bochum), but it's just over the bar.
18' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
14' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
13' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) will deliver the corner kick.
13' It seemed like Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
12' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Tim Kleindienst with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
8' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
7' Neat passing move from B. Monchengladbach in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Felix Passlack (Bochum) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
3' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
3' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is about to take a corner kick.
